Red Colobus monkey in Jozani forest. Endemic to Zanzibar.

The Zanzibar red colobus (Procolobus kirkii) is a species of red colobus monkey endemic to Unguja, the main island of the Zanzibar Archipelago. It is also known as Kirk's red colobus after Sir John Ki
